intro.welcome.text:
[i]Một Ngày Ở Xóm[/i] · A day in a Vũng Tàu hẻm.
You're staying at Bà Tư's family homestay in Hẻm 42, a short walk from Bãi Trước. It's 6 in the morning, and the hẻm is already busy. Walk around, eat, and fill your sổ tay (notebook) with what you learn.
intro.welcome.hint: Tap the street to walk. Tap a shop to go there. Tap the clock to wait.

batu.greet.speaker: batu
batu.greet.text: Ủa, con dậy rồi hả? [i]Ăn sáng chưa con?[/i]

phrases.en: Have you had breakfast yet, dear?

batu.reply_chua.speaker: batu
batu.reply_chua.text:
Chưa hả? Đi qua Cô Sáu ăn tô phở đi, kẻo hết!
(Not yet? Go have a bowl at Cô Sáu's before it runs out!)
batu.reply_chua.hint: “Ăn sáng chưa?” is a greeting. She's saying good morning, and she's also telling you where to eat.

batu.reply_english.speaker: batu
batu.reply_english.text: Haha, good morning! She smiles and points down the hẻm. “Phở, phở! Cô Sáu.”
batu.reply_english.hint: “Ăn sáng chưa?” is how neighbors say hi in the morning. Try “Dạ, chưa” (not yet) next time.

hem.tip.pho.text: Cô Sáu's phở is two doors from the homestay. Go before it sells out.

hem.tip.beach.text: Bãi Trước is at the end of the hẻm. Early morning is the time to go.

hem.tip.walk.text: Tap a shop to walk there, or tap the street to stroll.

hem.late.text: It's late. The hẻm is quiet and the shutters are down. Time to sleep.

home.morning.text: [i]Ngày {day}.[/i] You sleep. At {time} the hẻm is already awake: a broom on the concrete, a scooter warming up, sea wind, and the smell of broth from Cô Sáu's.

spot.home.look.text: Bà Tư's homestay. Your room upstairs has a fan and a window over the hẻm. From the kitchen comes the smell of nước mắm and something frying.
spot.home.look.hint: Coming in a later version: dinner with the family.

spot.pho.closed_before.speaker: cosau
spot.pho.closed_before.text: The shutter is half up. Cô Sáu is tending the pot. “Chưa mở con ơi, chút nữa nghen.” (Not open yet, a little later.)

phrases.vi: Chưa mở con ơi, chút nữa nghen.
phrases.en: Not open yet, dear. A little later, okay?

spot.pho.open.speaker: cosau
spot.pho.open.text: Steam rises from the big pot. Cô Sáu waves you to a low table. [i]Vô đây con, ngồi đi![/i]
spot.pho.open.hint: Coming in a later version: order a bowl and eat it the local way.

spot.pho.sold_out.speaker: cosau
spot.pho.sold_out.text: Cô Sáu is washing the last bowls. [i]Hết rồi con ơi![/i] Sáng mai đi sớm sớm nghen.

phrases.vi: Sáng mai đi sớm sớm nghen.

spot.pho.sold_out.hint: Phở is a morning food here. Most bowls are sold by 10 or 11.

spot.pho.closed_after.text: The shutter is down. Upstairs, a TV is on. Cô Sáu sells phở in the morning only, from {open} until it runs out.
spot.pho.closed_after.hint: Phở is a morning food here. Come back early tomorrow.

spot.banhmi.look.text: Warm loaves stacked behind glass. A line of people in work clothes and school uniforms.
spot.banhmi.look.hint: Coming in a later version: build your own bánh mì.

spot.coc.look.text: Plastic stools along the wall, glasses with a phin dripping on top. Two men argue about football. Nobody is in a hurry.
spot.coc.look.hint: Coming in a later version: order a cà phê sữa đá and wait for the drip.

spot.coc.closed.text: The stools are stacked against the wall. Coffee starts again at {open}.

spot.bac.look.speaker: bacha
spot.bac.look.text: Mời cháu vào ăn phở! (Come in for phở!) Bác Hà speaks with a Northern accent. On her table: chili, lime, garlic vinegar. No bean sprouts. No hoisin.
spot.bac.look.hint: Coming in a later version. We want Northern cooks to help write this shop.

spot.bac.closed.text: Shutter down. Bác Hà sells in the morning only.

spot.mia.look.text: The press squeaks. Cane goes in, green-gold juice comes out over ice, with a squeeze of tắc.

spot.banhkhot.look.text: Cô Út pours rice batter into a hot mold full of little cups, drops a shrimp in each, and covers it. They come out crispy and yellow, one bite each. At the table: lettuce, herbs, and a bowl of nước mắm.
spot.banhkhot.look.hint: Coming in a later version: eat a plate. Vũng Tàu is known for bánh khọt.

spot.banhkhot.closed.text: Shutter down. Cô Út starts the fire at {open} in the morning.

spot.hvl.look.text: A basket of warm duck eggs under a cloth. A man cracks the top of one, sips the broth, adds salt and pepper, and eats it with rau răm. Next to him, a girl orders hers fried in tamarind sauce.
spot.hvl.look.hint: Coming in a later version: try one, if you dare.

spot.go.look.text: [i]Lóc cóc, lóc cóc.[/i] The helper clacks two bamboo sticks as he walks. Call out from your door, and the bowl comes to you.

spot.beach.dawn.text: The boats are in. Fish are sorted on the sand, and neighbors buy them right there. Behind them, people jog, stretch, and swing their arms before the sun gets hot.
spot.beach.dawn.hint: Coming in a later version: buy fish for Bà Tư's kitchen.

spot.beach.day.text: The sun is hot. The sand is almost empty, and the boats wait out at sea.
spot.beach.day.hint: Come back very early in the morning.

spot.beach.evening.text: The heat breaks. Families sit on mats, kids run at the water, and scooters roll along the coast road.
spot.beach.evening.hint: Coming in a later version: ride a scooter along the coast. Helmet on.

spot.beach.night.text: Dark water and the sound of waves. Far out, the lights of fishing boats.
